newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei ends at day's high after early losses.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei ends at day's high after early losses.

text.p: Tokyo stocks recouped earlier losses to end slightly higher in mostly directionless trade on Friday. Aggressive investor buying, which gave a boost to the Nikkei average earlier this week, withered and range-bound trade looks likely to return next week, brokers said.
The key Nikkei 225 average was up 72.77 points or 0.34 percent to finish at 21,216.11, its highest level for the day. Its December futures gained 80 points to 21,250.
"Sentiment seems to have made a turn for the better, but the index remains in a boxed range," said Kaoru Ichikawa, a senior trader at Kokusai Securities Co Ltd.
